properties.query:
CommonSecurityLog 
| where DeviceVendor has 'Silverfort'
| where DeviceProduct has 'Admin Console'
| where DeviceEventClassID == "NewIncident"
| where Message has "NoPacBreach"
| extend IncidentData = parse_json(replace('^""|""$', '', Message))
| extend UserName = coalesce(
    tostring(IncidentData.data.users[0].samAccountName),
    tostring(IncidentData.data.users[0].upn),
    tostring(IncidentData.data.users[0].displayName),
    tostring(IncidentData.users[0].displayName)
)
properties.description: Identifies Silverfort incidents associated with exploitation of the NoPac vulnerabilities in Active Directory. This behavior may allow an attacker to escalate privileges and compromise the domain.
properties.name: Silverfort - NoPacBreach Incident
